title: زبان انگلیسی

chapters.title: Unit 1: My Nationality
chapters.summary: Theme: My Nationality. Students practice introducing themselves and other people, asking where someone is from, naming countries and nationalities, and spelling familiar words. Learning should combine listening, speaking, reading and writing.
points: Communication: asking and answering about country and nationality.
Vocabulary: country names and nationality words such as Iran/Iranian and Canada/Canadian.
Listening and speaking: understanding short introductions and introducing a classmate.
Reading and writing: recognizing and spelling familiar words; practicing common letter combinations.
chapters.example: Pair practice: introduce a classmate to a visitor and ask where the visitor is from.
solutionSteps: کشور را مشخص می‌کنیم.
صفت ملیت را انتخاب می‌کنیم.
جمله را با فاعل و فعل مناسب می‌سازیم.

questions.question: What is the nationality of a person from Canada?
questions.explanation: A person from Canada is Canadian.

questions.question: Which question asks about a person's country?
questions.explanation: Where are you from? asks about a person's country or place of origin.

questions.question: Which spelling is correct for the nationality of a person from Iran?
questions.explanation: The correct word is Iranian.

commonMistakes: نام کشور با ملیت یکی نیست؛ country نام کشور و nationality صفت یا نام ملیت است.
نام کشورها و ملیت‌ها در انگلیسی با حرف بزرگ آغاز می‌شوند؛ مثل Iran و Iranian.

chapters.title: Unit 2: My Week
chapters.summary: Theme: My Week. Students talk about daily routines and weekly activities, ask when and on which days activities happen, and understand short conversations about helping and planning.
points: Communication: talking about daily activities and weekly routines.
Vocabulary: days of the week and common activities.
Listening and speaking: asking about a person's schedule and responding clearly.
Reading and writing: completing simple weekly schedules and writing about familiar routines.
chapters.example: Ask a partner what they do on two different days, then write a short weekly schedule.
solutionSteps: روزهای فعالیت را مشخص می‌کنیم.
فاعل و فعل مناسب را انتخاب می‌کنیم.
قید تکرار را در جای مناسب می‌گذاریم.

questions.question: Which expression asks about the day of an activity?
questions.explanation: What days do you ...? asks on which days an activity happens.

questions.question: Which word names the day after Tuesday?
questions.explanation: Wednesday comes after Tuesday.

questions.question: Which answer is suitable for “When do you study English?”
questions.explanation: The question asks about time, so a day/time answer is appropriate.

commonMistakes: برای روزهای هفته معمولاً از on استفاده می‌کنیم؛ روز را با ساعت یا بخش روز اشتباه نگیر.
در برنامهٔ هفتگی، فعالیت و روز آن را با فاعل و فعل درست بنویس؛ فقط فهرست واژه‌ها کافی نیست.

chapters.title: Unit 3: My Abilities
chapters.summary: Theme: My Abilities. Students describe what they can do, ask about other people's abilities, and understand short conversations about skills and activities.
points: Communication: asking and answering about abilities.
Vocabulary: activities and skills such as swimming, drawing and speaking.
Listening and speaking: asking a classmate what they are good at.
Reading and writing: understanding short descriptions of abilities and writing about one's own skills.
chapters.example: Ask a classmate about two activities and introduce one ability they have to the group.
solutionSteps: توانایی را مشخص می‌کنیم.
فاعل را می‌آوریم.
can یا can't و شکل ساده فعل را می‌نویسیم.

questions.question: Which question asks about someone's ability?
questions.explanation: Can you swim? asks whether someone has the ability to swim.

questions.question: What does “I am good at drawing” mean?
questions.explanation: The sentence says that the speaker is skilled at drawing.

questions.question: Which answer is suitable for “Can you ride a bicycle?”
questions.explanation: The question asks about ability, so yes/no with can is suitable.

commonMistakes: بعد از can و can't فعل به شکل ساده می‌آید؛ به آن s یا to اضافه نکن.
can و can't خودشان توانایی یا ناتوانی را نشان می‌دهند؛ برای پرسش از ترتیب Can + subject استفاده کن.

chapters.title: Unit 4: My Health
chapters.summary: Theme: My Health. Students name common health problems, ask how someone feels, and give simple health advice. Role-play supports listening and speaking in everyday situations.
points: Communication: talking about health problems and giving advice.
Vocabulary: common problems such as headache and toothache.
Listening and speaking: asking what is wrong and suggesting suitable help.
Reading and writing: understanding short health messages and writing simple advice.
chapters.example: Role-play: one student describes a simple health problem; the other gives a suitable, safe suggestion.
solutionSteps: مشکل را بیان می‌کنیم.
پرسش مناسب می‌پرسیم.
پاسخ و توصیه ساده می‌دهیم.

questions.question: What does “headache” mean?
questions.explanation: Headache means سردرد.

questions.question: Which expression gives advice?
questions.explanation: You should ... is used to give advice.

questions.question: Which question asks about a health problem?
questions.explanation: What's the matter? asks what problem someone has.

commonMistakes: برای بیان مشکل معمولاً از ساختار مناسب مانند have a headache یا have a toothache استفاده می‌شود؛ واژهٔ نشانه را با خود بیماری اشتباه نگیر.
در توصیهٔ ساده، بعد از should فعل ساده می‌آید؛ به should شکل گذشته یا s اضافه نکن.

chapters.title: Unit 5: My City
chapters.summary: Theme: My City. Students describe places in a city, ask about locations and understand simple information about familiar places.
points: Communication: describing a city and asking about places.
Vocabulary: common city places and location words.
Listening and speaking: asking for and giving simple information about places.
Reading and writing: understanding a short description or map-based text and writing about a familiar city.
chapters.example: Describe three places in your city and explain where one of them is in relation to another.
solutionSteps: مکان‌های مهم را انتخاب می‌کنیم.
مفرد یا جمع بودن را می‌سنجیم.
از there is یا there are استفاده می‌کنیم.

questions.question: Which word means «بیمارستان»?
questions.explanation: Hospital means بیمارستان.

questions.question: Which place is usually used to borrow books?
questions.explanation: A library is a place where people can read or borrow books.

questions.question: Which question is useful when asking about a place?
questions.explanation: Where is the museum? asks for the location of a place.

commonMistakes: there is برای اسم مفرد و there are برای اسم جمع به کار می‌رود؛ انتخاب را بر اساس اسم بعد از آن انجام بده.
نام مکان را با جایگاه آن اشتباه نگیر؛ توصیف یک شهر باید مکان‌ها و رابطهٔ مکانی را روشن کند.

chapters.title: Unit 6: My Village
chapters.summary: Theme: My Village. Students describe village life, natural places and familiar activities, and compare features of places using simple spoken and written language.
points: Communication: describing a village and its surroundings.
Vocabulary: nature and village words such as river, field and mountain.
Listening and speaking: talking about familiar places and daily life.
Reading and writing: understanding and producing short descriptions of a village.
chapters.example: Write a short description of a village or rural place, including two natural features and one activity.
solutionSteps: موضوع پرسش را مشخص می‌کنیم: مکان یا آب‌وهوا.
واژه‌های مناسب مکان و فصل را انتخاب می‌کنیم.
جمله را با فاعل و فعل درست می‌سازیم.

questions.question: What does “village” mean?
questions.explanation: Village means روستا.

questions.question: Which word means «رودخانه»?
questions.explanation: River means رودخانه.

questions.question: Which sentence best describes a natural place?
options: There is a river near the village.
questions.explanation: The sentence describes a natural feature near a village.

commonMistakes: نام فصل‌ها و ویژگی‌های آب‌وهوا را با هم اشتباه نگیر؛ برای مثال season با weather یکسان نیست.
برای توصیف مکان، از واژهٔ دقیق مانند river، field یا mountain استفاده کن؛ واژه‌های طبیعی را جابه‌جا نکن.

chapters.title: Unit 7: My Hobbies
chapters.summary: Theme: My Hobbies. Students talk about hobbies and free-time activities, ask others about their interests, and understand short descriptions of what people enjoy doing.
points: Communication: asking and answering about hobbies and free time.
Vocabulary: common activities such as reading, swimming and playing games.
Listening and speaking: asking a partner about favourite activities.
Reading and writing: describing a hobby and writing a few sentences about free time.
chapters.example: Ask a partner about a favourite hobby and write three original sentences about when and why they enjoy it.
solutionSteps: فعالیت یا سرگرمی مورد نظر را انتخاب می‌کنیم.
از واژه مناسب برای علاقه یا پرسش استفاده می‌کنیم.
جمله را با ترتیب درست می‌نویسیم.

questions.question: What does “hobby” mean?
questions.explanation: Hobby means سرگرمی.

questions.question: Which question asks about a person's hobby?
questions.explanation: What is your hobby? asks about a favourite free-time activity.

questions.question: Which word means «مطالعه کردن»?
questions.explanation: Reading means مطالعه کردن or خواندن.

commonMistakes: برای بیان علاقه به فعالیت، ساختارهایی مانند like + verb-ing یا enjoy + verb-ing را با شکل سادهٔ فعل اشتباه نگیر.
پرسش دربارهٔ سرگرمی با پاسخ دربارهٔ توانایی یکسان نیست؛ hobby و ability را از هم جدا کن.
